2014-onwards power-unit rules that Mercedes first solved.

How Hybrid era connects

  • Faction: Mercedes-AMG Petronas — Mercedes solved the 2014 hybrid rules first and built a dynasty on them.
  • Topic: Formula 1 — The hybrid era is the 2014-onwards regulations chapter of Formula 1.
  • Concept: DRS — DRS is the overtaking aid that frames how hybrid-era races look.

What is Hybrid era?

The hybrid era is the Formula 1 regulations period that began in 2014 with turbo-hybrid power units. Mercedes won the first stretch; Red Bull later took the advantage.

Key threads lead to Mercedes-AMG Petronas, Formula 1 and DRS.
